description:
Reproduced 2026-09-14 at main f26264572 on every door:

    def main() do
      k = :a
      case %{a: 7} do
        %{^k => v} -> dbg({:got, v})
        _ -> dbg(:no)
      end
    end

thread 'main' panicked at src/dispatch_matrix/pattern/source.rs:211: resolved source-pattern dispatch analysis must compile: SourcePattern(UnsupportedMapKey). Elixir prints {:got, 7}: a map key in a pattern may be a literal or a pinned variable (elixir_map.erl:73-77, :263-268).

Two defects: the exhaustiveness analysis calls expect() on a user-input outcome, and the producer has no map-key region for a pinned key (Region::MapKeyPresent takes a constant). Fix: the analysis maps SourcePatternError to a diagnostic like every other producer error; the producer models a pinned key as a prepared-key question fed by the pin's runtime word on the three doors. Signal: the program above with an oracle twin; a fixture with a non-literal, non-pinned key (`%{k => v}`) pins Elixir's diagnostic "cannot use variable k as map key inside a pattern".
title: A pinned map key in a pattern panics the compiler
